english_research_meaning: Loss of a best-effort debug log normally degrades observability rather than retroactively falsifying the domain result.
material_countercase: A product policy may classify a particular diagnostic evidence stream as required for some sensitive action; best-effort is scope-specific.

english_research_meaning: When the analytic operation already failed and Problem registration also fails, retain analytic FAILURE and separate registration_state=NOT_WRITTEN, with no invented platform ProblemRef.
material_countercase: Local protected evidence may be retained; missing platform acknowledgement does not imply a successfully registered occurrence.

english_research_meaning: An ambiguous recorder acknowledgement creates registration_state=OUTCOME_UNKNOWN independently of domain outcome, requiring query/reconciliation instead of blind duplicate registration.
material_countercase: A client exception during recording cannot prove that the platform never stored the ProblemOccurrence.

english_research_meaning: For an operation whose policy requires durable mandatory audit before a destructive effect, inability to establish that audit must block the action.
material_countercase: This is conditional on a designated mandatory-audit policy, not a universal ban on read-only calculation during log outage.

english_research_meaning: Disk-full logging requires bounded emergency channel, dropped-record counts, scoped Node/resource warning and policy-governed cleanup without silent claims of complete evidence.
material_countercase: Emergency sink also may fail; no magic zero-loss guarantee under physical exhaustion.

english_research_meaning: Before AppContext or platform Node identity exists, startup errors use minimal stderr/bootstrap file/ring buffer, later linked to owner context when possible.
material_countercase: Pre-Node errors must not receive fabricated ProblemRefs or assume that runtime registration was available.

english_research_meaning: Useful reliability measures include queue wait, run duration, counts by success/partial/cancel/failure/unknown, retry, lag, progress stall, grouped faults, dropped logs and observability write failures.
material_countercase: Metric labels/values must exclude business payload, secret-bearing URL and private parameters; metrics are secondary to exact effect evidence.

english_research_meaning: Optional OpenTelemetry/W3C Trace Context is an interoperability/export projection of internal causal IDs and must not replace Case/Job/Attempt/Problem identity.
material_countercase: External trace baggage must be scoped and scrubbed; an observability stack is not mandatory for initial local execution.

english_research_meaning: A bounded Case-level support bundle may contain product revision, run/case refs, safe runtime snapshot, redacted log excerpts, Artifact metadata and a redaction report.
material_countercase: Exclude raw business data, credentials, full workspace and unrestricted environment by default; explicit user/control authorization and availability proofs still needed.

english_research_meaning: Diagnostics are bounded read-only tests returning qualified PASS/WARN/FAIL/UNKNOWN/SKIPPED, while repair is a distinct authorized mutating command with separate audit and actual postcondition verification.
material_countercase: A diagnostic cannot secretly act as a repair merely because its UI button and operator are the same.
